request.idea: Maya finds a lonely star that is scared to go back into the sky.

bible.title: A Blink for the Sky
bible.narrativeComplexity: a simple cause, with one feeling shown in what someone does
bible.userIdea: Maya finds a lonely star that is scared to go back into the sky.
bible.premise: When maya finds a lonely star hiding beside a flowerpot, its light folds inward whenever it looks up. It is scared of returning back into the wide darkness without someone answering.
bible.hook: A small light under a flowerpot goes out whenever Maya looks up.
bible.goal: Help the star find an answering light before it returns skyward.
bible.centralProblem: The star hides from the sky because it expects silence.
bible.stakes: Without an answer, the star will remain hidden beneath the garden wall.
emotionalArc: Gentle shelter allows a first exchange.
An answering signal makes distance possible.
A quiet exchange continues across the sky.
bible.motif: Light covered, light uncovered, light answered.
